replication.target_description: Classification of stimuli as good or bad in the replication using tiles. Two-tailed single-sample t test of good-evaluation ratio versus .618; published 2012 article, p.187.

n.exclusions: Five instruction violators excluded from 90; six who evaluated then placed all items into one bag retained.
n.quote:
All participants who evaluated tiles (n = 34), wooden spheres (n = 26),
or beans (n = 25) and did not violate the instructions

reported_success.quote:
The results indicated that those in the wooden sphere and tile groups,
as well as across all three groups collectively, judged the items as “good”
in accordance to the predictions of V. A. Lefebvre’s mathematical model

notes: Rendered PDF p.187 checked. Narrative additionally cautions that individual data give less clear support; success records the authors’ target-group verdict. Pooled n=85 is explicitly printed in the sample-size test and agrees with listed group sizes.
